classification_boundary: pending/not_reviewed/not_reaudited are prioritization states, not safety classifications

array_into_iter_alive_range.bounds_or_initialization_proof: PolymorphicIter maintains start <= end <= N and exactly data[alive] initialized. take_prefix and take_suffix return subsets of that same alive range before the unchecked drop; their lengths are min(n, old_len), so n - returned_len cannot underflow.
array_into_iter_alive_range.callback_and_mutation_proof: The alive range is updated before element drop glue can run. Character case iterators only delegate to the same private IntoIter state.
array_into_iter_alive_range.safe_public_boundary: Safe array IntoIterator construction initializes all N elements and sets alive to 0..N. The partial-array constructor remains unsafe and is outside the safe-public claim.
array_into_iter_alive_range.same_object_proof: The returned IndexRange and the unchecked slice are both derived from the same private PolymorphicIter data array.
array_into_iter_alive_range.unwind_proof: Removing the selected region from alive before assume_init_drop means an element destructor panic leaves the iterator owning only the disjoint remaining initialized region; iterator drop cannot double-drop the removed region.

ascii_fixed_chunks.bounds_or_initialization_proof: as_chunks::<64> and as_chunks::<16> yield references to exact-size initialized arrays. The four NEON loads are at offsets 0, 16, 32, and 48 of a 64-byte array; the tail load starts at an exact 16-byte array.
ascii_fixed_chunks.callback_and_mutation_proof: The checks contain no user callback and operate through an immutable byte slice for the duration of all loads.
ascii_fixed_chunks.safe_public_boundary: The public array, slice, str, and Wtf8 ASCII predicates pass valid immutable byte slices; as_ascii performs the predicate before the representation-preserving cast.
ascii_fixed_chunks.same_object_proof: Every SIMD pointer is obtained directly from the fixed chunk returned from the exact input slice.
ascii_fixed_chunks.unwind_proof: The intrinsic loads and integer reductions do not invoke user code or destructors; a failed ASCII test returns before any unsafe ASCII reference is constructed.

binary_search_indices.bounds_or_initialization_proof: slice::binary_search_by returns Ok(idx) only for an element selected inside the searched slice. Both unchecked LUT accesses consume that exact Ok index; the preceding l1_luts access is safe and may return early. The generic binary search maintains mid < self.len().
binary_search_indices.callback_and_mutation_proof: The Unicode comparator closes over immutable scalar input and static tables. It cannot resize, relocate, or mutate the searched slice.
binary_search_indices.safe_public_boundary: All conversion roots accept a valid char and query immutable generated Unicode tables.
binary_search_indices.same_object_proof: Each Ok index is returned by binary_search on the same singles or multis slice subsequently indexed unchecked.
binary_search_indices.unwind_proof: A comparator panic unwinds out of binary_search before it returns Ok, so neither unchecked access is reached.

initialized_value_moves.bounds_or_initialization_proof: mem::replace reads through an exclusive reference to an initialized T and immediately writes the initialized replacement without a panic point. mem::take delegates to replace. ManuallyDrop::into_inner consumes a valid ManuallyDrop<T>. IoSlice removal counts cannot exceed the slice length, rotations assert their split and operate within the original slice, and RangeFrom replaces its valid start value.
initialized_value_moves.callback_and_mutation_proof: No user callback runs between the raw read and replacement write. Rotation performs raw moves without invoking T::Drop; IoSlice advance checks precede mutation.
initialized_value_moves.safe_public_boundary: The scoped roots receive safe references or owned valid Rust values. Producing an invalid T, invalid reference, or invalid ManuallyDrop<T> would already require violating an unsafe caller obligation.
initialized_value_moves.same_object_proof: Every raw read is from the exact referenced or owned storage being consumed or immediately replaced; slice and IoSlice state updates derive from that same storage.
initialized_value_moves.unwind_proof: replace has no operation that can unwind between read and write. Slice state is narrowed before later fallible work, and rotation performs no panic-capable user operation while a temporary owns a moved element.

integer_format_buffer.bounds_or_initialization_proof: NumBuffer<i128/u128> has a closed primitive-specific buffer size. enc_16lsd is called only with offsets whose 16-byte region fits, and quad_index in 1..4 selects four disjoint four-byte subranges inside that region. The remainder is below 10,000 before write_quad.
integer_format_buffer.callback_and_mutation_proof: Formatting arithmetic and fixed-table copies invoke no user callback while the buffer is partially initialized.
integer_format_buffer.safe_public_boundary: format_into accepts only NumBuffer for the concrete primitive; downstream code cannot provide a smaller buffer implementation for i128 or u128.
integer_format_buffer.same_object_proof: All subranges are taken from the same primitive-specific NumBuffer passed to _fmt_inner and enc_16lsd.
integer_format_buffer.unwind_proof: The integer operations and MaybeUninit writes do not call user code; an assertion failure occurs before the corresponding unchecked range and no partially initialized buffer is exposed.

stable_sort_pivot.bounds_or_initialization_proof: Stable sort reaches quicksort only for a non-ZST slice above the small-sort threshold. choose_pivot requires len >= 8 and returns an index within the same slice; ptr::read reads one initialized element as MaybeUninit<T>.
stable_sort_pivot.callback_and_mutation_proof: A temporary pivot reference is created only when T has no direct interior mutability. For non-Freeze T, pivot_ref is None, preventing comparator-driven mutation from making the copied pivot stale or duplicating ownership.
stable_sort_pivot.safe_public_boundary: The public stable sort roots start from an exclusive initialized slice and a safe comparison callback; comparator inconsistency may make order unspecified but does not relax memory-safety invariants.
stable_sort_pivot.same_object_proof: choose_pivot samples and returns an offset within the exact v slice from which pivot_copy is read.
stable_sort_pivot.unwind_proof: pivot_copy is MaybeUninit<T> and is not dropped as a duplicate T. Comparator panic unwinds while the original slice remains initialized; the temporary copy does not escape.

str_range_normalization.bounds_or_initialization_proof: Safe get/get_mut paths require start <= end <= len and both UTF-8 boundaries before unchecked slicing. Panicking index paths perform the same checks. Inclusive endpoints require end < len before end + 1; arbitrary Bound pairs are normalized with checked overflow and bounds handling.
str_range_normalization.callback_and_mutation_proof: Range-bound methods finish before unchecked access. The shared or exclusive string borrow prevents safe relocation or mutation of its byte length between check and access.
str_range_normalization.safe_public_boundary: Only the safe SliceIndex get/get_mut/index/index_mut roots are classified here; direct get_unchecked remains an unsafe caller contract.
str_range_normalization.same_object_proof: The range checks and the unchecked slice operate on the same str and its exact byte length.
str_range_normalization.unwind_proof: Overflow, invalid order, out-of-bounds, or non-boundary inputs return None or panic before unchecked slicing; no destructor or callback runs after validation and before the sink.

two_way_string_search.bounds_or_initialization_proof: Empty needles use a separate EmptyNeedle state. For a nonempty needle, each forward search iteration first proves position + needle.len() - 1 < haystack.len(); loop indices are at most that last index. Reverse search first proves end >= needle.len() and end - needle.len() < haystack.len(), while i < needle.len() and end <= haystack.len().
two_way_string_search.callback_and_mutation_proof: The algorithm reads immutable haystack and needle bytes only. Every position/end mutation either returns or continues to the loop head, which re-establishes the bound before another unchecked access.
two_way_string_search.safe_public_boundary: StrSearcher::new separates empty needles and receives valid immutable UTF-8 haystack and needle references from safe Pattern APIs.
two_way_string_search.same_object_proof: The guard and each unchecked access use the exact same haystack slice and needle length held by the searcher.
two_way_string_search.unwind_proof: The byte comparisons invoke no user code; there is no unwind point between the top-of-iteration bound check and the unchecked byte access.
